collection.description: A jeweler wants the shell of the season's only living conch for a horn.

premise.name: The premise
premise.text: A jeweler wants the shell of a rare living conch for a ceremonial horn; divers have seen only one this season.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: The jeweler uses a weathered empty shell and discovers its rough edges make a distinctive sound.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: Divers find several juveniles but no evidence the population can withstand harvesting; the decision is delayed.

c.name: Answer C
c.text: A clay-and-shell instrument sounds different but becomes its own tradition.
